name: hcapp_updatePhotoStatus
description: Allows an authorised reviewer (Hash Flash 0x20, GM 0x02, VGM 0x04, or RA 0x08) to action a photo. Works on photos of any current status — supports re-review from the Reviewed tab and initial review from the Pending tab. Action 1 soft-deletes by setting DeletedAt (Status is unchanged). Actions 2-6 clear DeletedAt and set the new Status, effectively restoring soft-deleted photos. Action 6 additionally propagates BlobUrl to HC.Event.EventCoverPhotoUrl.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth for auth resolution.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret.

parameters.name: photoId
parameters.description: UUID of the photo to action. If no KennelPhotos row matches, a 'Photo not found' error is returned (errorCode 1333, errorType 13).

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Action to apply. 1=soft-delete (set DeletedAt, Status unchanged). 2=keep_private (Status=0, clear DeletedAt). 3=share (Status=2, clear DeletedAt). 4=run_gallery (Status=3, clear DeletedAt). 5=home_gallery (Status=4, clear DeletedAt). 6=event_cover (Status=5, clear DeletedAt, propagate BlobUrl to Event.EventCoverPhotoUrl). Values outside 1-6 trigger a validation error (errorCode 1233, errorType 12).

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Always present. On auth, validation, photo-not-found, or role check failure: success=0, errorCode and errorType set. On DB error: success=0, errorCode=1933, errorType=19. On success: success=1, errorCode=NULL, errorType=NULL.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Numeric error code. NULL on success.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Error classification code. NULL on success.

rowsets.name: ActionResult
rowsets.description: On success: the photo ID, the new resolved status, and the new DeletedAt value. On error: standard HC6 error detail rowset. These two shapes are mutually exclusive at index 1.

columns.name: newStatus
columns.description: The status after the action. For action=1 (soft-delete), this is 0 (the CASE ELSE default) — note this is misleading since the row is soft-deleted, not truly private. For actions 2-6, this reflects the new explicit status.

columns.name: deletedAt
columns.description: The new DeletedAt value. Non-null (GETUTCDATE()) for action=1. NULL for actions 2-6.

sideEffects: Updates KennelPhotos.DeletedAt and KennelPhotos.UpdatedAt for action=1.
Updates KennelPhotos.Status, KennelPhotos.DeletedAt, and KennelPhotos.UpdatedAt for actions 2-6.
When action=6: updates HC.Event.EventCoverPhotoUrl with BlobUrl (not EditedBlobUrl — note: hcapp_batchUpdatePhotoStatus uses COALESCE(EditedBlobUrl, BlobUrl) but this SP uses only BlobUrl).
Writes to HC.ErrorLog on invalid action, photo-not-found, role check failure, or unhandled DB error.

codeSmells.issue: action=6 writes BlobUrl to EventCoverPhotoUrl, not COALESCE(EditedBlobUrl, BlobUrl)
codeSmells.detail: hcapp_batchUpdatePhotoStatus uses COALESCE(kp.EditedBlobUrl, kp.BlobUrl) when setting EventCoverPhotoUrl for action=6, correctly preferring the edited version. This SP uses only @photoBlobUrl (the original BlobUrl fetched before the transaction). If a photo has been cropped via hcapp_updateRunPhotoEditedBlob, the event cover will point to the unedited original. This is an inconsistency between the single-item and batch action paths.

The CASE expression that computes @newStatus defaults WHEN 1 THEN 0, so when action=1 (soft-delete), the returned newStatus is 0 (private) even though the photo is soft-deleted (DeletedAt is set). A caller reading newStatus=0 cannot distinguish a soft-deleted photo from a truly private one — they must inspect deletedAt.

codeSmells.issue: Role mask 0x002E excludes WebMeister — inconsistent with hcapp_batchUpdatePhotoStatus
codeSmells.detail: This single-item action SP uses 0x002E. hcapp_batchUpdatePhotoStatus uses 0x102E (adds WebMeister 0x1000). A WebMeister can batch-action but not single-action photos.

codeSmells.issue: HcVersion hardcoded to '<unknown>' in all ErrorLog inserts
codeSmells.detail: Consistent with other HC6 SPs but means the version is never captured in the error log.

breakingChanges: New SP — no HC5 predecessor. No breaking changes from migration.
